content: Hello, I am Meridian Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
No, sorry, Alex is away at the moment. Could you call back today at half past four?
I cannot call back today. When can Mx Rowan be reached?
Then make it five o'clock today, that's really the best time to catch Alex.
That time is not possible. Could we try the next business day, Thursday 15 October 2026, or Monday 19 October 2026, between 08:30 and 16:30?
I'm not able to commit to a time on Alex's behalf, I'm afraid. I'll let Alex know Meridian Bank called, so Alex can get back to you.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
